what: Resolves cairn test targets to proof files: a file stays a file, a directory expands to **/proofs/test_*.py (and a proofs/ directory to its test_*.py), a missing path is printed and kept so the run reports it unrunnable. Standard library only.
why: RULE 1: validation.py (a tool every gate imports) reached into the tester device for this one stdlib function; a function with no device in it belongs on the tool rung, where every user reaches it the same way (ticket 67b78ae59c1d). Stdlib-only also keeps every gate that imports it clear of the bus and any oracle.
